## 8. Verdict (risk 1: hidden order dependency)

- Section 4: no Bill line of the function reads a VP field, so moving every VP read to the end of the function (ReadProfile) cannot change a value a Bill line sees.
- Section 3: the only Bill field touched inside a VP hunk is `chromaUpscaler`: the `chroma_upscaler` choice read (pre-move 2753) with the extended choice list. That line stays in Bill's function (now LVR 2201, a Bill-line edit for the divergence register); it is a Bill field read by Bill's own code, so its position is unchanged and no VP read depends on it.
- Section 5 `active` and `value` are false positives (the word in a comment; a lambda-scoped scratch). Section 7: no Bill local read by VP lines is assigned by Bill lines after the first VP use, except the scratch `value`, which every VP use assigns through TryGetString before reading.
- The only unconditional early return is `rule.name.empty()` before the first VP line, so the end-of-function ReadProfile call is skipped exactly when the pre-move VP code was.
- Behavioural proof stays the identity dump (settings-identity.golden.txt) over the frozen corpus.
- Method caveat: VP lines are identified by difflib against Bill's a591ad3b text, so a Bill line changed upstream after that point would appear as VP; none of the 9 hunks contains one beyond the `chromaUpscaler` line.
